causes.label: Helping people find care
causes.programs: Resource Guide · Find a Therapist Directory · one-on-one resource navigation
causes.impact: When someone you love is struggling, the hardest part is knowing who to call. The Resource Guide and the directory put the answer in one place, in print and online.

causes.label: Peer and family support
causes.programs: NAMI Connection peer groups · Family Support Groups · more than 50 gatherings every month
causes.impact: Every group is led by people who have lived it. Nobody pays to attend, and nobody needs insurance or a referral to walk in.

causes.label: Education for families and schools
causes.programs: Family-to-Family · Peer-to-Peer · Basics · Ending the Silence · In Our Own Voice
causes.impact: Free classes and presentations taught by trained volunteers give families and young people the words and the tools to cope.

causes.label: Mental health at work
causes.programs: Presentations for employees · StigmaFree Workplace · Mental Health Champions
causes.impact: Bring a NAMI presentation to your own team. It tells every employee that it is safe to ask for help, and where to find it.

causes.label: Reaching rural communities
causes.programs: Outreach across Crook and Jefferson counties and the Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs
causes.impact: In much of Central Oregon, help is a long drive away. Outreach brings classes, groups and resources to the towns where people live.

causes.label: Awareness and community
causes.programs: NAMIWalks Central Oregon · Be Kind to Your Mind podcast · community events
causes.impact: Public events and local stories make it normal to talk about mental health, long before anyone reaches a crisis.

causes.label: The whole mission
causes.programs: Every program above, wherever the need is greatest
causes.impact: An annual partnership is the most flexible support there is. It keeps every group, class and resource free, all year.

champions.title: Mental Health Champions
champions.body: Recognition for businesses that take real steps for mental health at work and in the community. It is earned through engagement, not purchased, and any business can take part whether or not it sponsors.
actions: Host one NAMI presentation for your team
Share NAMI resources with every employee once a year

champions.disclaimer: Mental Health Champions is a community recognition. NAMI Central Oregon does not certify, clinically evaluate or endorse any workplace, product or service.

timeline.what: Your commitment is recorded and your invoice is ready to open right away.
Your partner badge is on your confirmation page, ready to post.
Our Regional Director sends your welcome note and confirms your recognition details.
Your name or logo goes up on our Partners page.
Newsletter, social and project recognition follow the schedule in your welcome note.
We send a renewal link with your package already selected. No new proposal.

payment.onlineNote: Tell us how you would like to pay. Payment details are on your invoice.

agreement: We commit to the sponsorship selected above for the current program year.
NAMI Central Oregon will provide the recognition listed for each selection, on the published timeline.
Recognition acknowledges our support. It is not an endorsement of our business, products or services by NAMI Central Oregon.
Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date. Recognition begins once payment is received.
We grant NAMI Central Oregon permission to use our name and logo for the recognition described.

faq.q: Can we sponsor one project without an annual partnership?
faq.a: Yes. Pick any project on its own, or combine it with an annual partnership. Either way it is one form and one invoice.
NAMIWalks keeps its own sponsor levels and its own identity. You can add a NAMIWalks sponsorship here so everything sits on the same invoice.
Tell us at the last step whether you prefer card, check or bank transfer. Your invoice is ready as soon as you confirm, and it carries the payment details.

faq.q: How much of our time will this take?
faq.a: About three minutes to choose and confirm. After that we only contact you when something of yours goes live, and once a year to ask about renewing.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: A contact person, your logo, a one-sentence description and how you would like your name to appear. That is all, and you enter it once.
No. Recognition thanks a business for its support. NAMI Central Oregon does not endorse businesses, products or services.
